creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-07 while building pane names: in crates/muster-cli/tests/cli/without_a_window.rs, a pane send --confirm to p1 late in the sequence, after the hiding_and_quiet_are_asked_of_the_daemon steps, failed; the same send earlier passed, so it was moved earlier rather than explained. It resolved to p1, so it is not a naming issue. Check whether hiding and showing a pane with no window leaves it in a state a confirmed send cannot read back (its terminal size, its screen, or the send's read-back), or whether it is ordering in the test.
title: A windowless confirmed send failed after hide and quiet in the same test sequence
